title: Beyond Uniform Token Training: A Multi-Target Framework for Learning Token-Weighted Objectives in Generative Recommenders
abstract: arXiv:2601.17787v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent generative recommendation models recast next-item prediction as the generation of a semantic identifier sequence. While this formulation enables autoregressive models to produce item IDs directly, the commonly used token-level likelihood objective does not distinguish between tokens that play different roles in item identification. This limitation is especially pronounced for semantic-ID representations, where prefix tokens often determine coarse item groups and later tokens provide finer-grained disambiguation. To better align training with the structure of semantic IDs, we study token-level learning signals from two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce a prefix-aware weighting scheme, Front-Greater Weighting, which emphasizes tokens according to their contribution to reducing semantic ambiguity among candidate items. translated_title: 超越统一令牌训练：一种用于生成式推荐器中学习令牌加权目标的多目标框架
translated_abstract: 最近生成的推荐模型将下一项预测重新定义为生成语义标识符序列。虽然这种表述使自回归模型能够直接生成物品ID，但常用的令牌级似然目标并未区分在物品识别中扮演不同角色的令牌。这一局限性在语义ID表示中尤为明显，其中前缀令牌通常决定粗粒度物品组，而后缀令牌提供更细粒度的消歧。为了更好地将训练与语义ID的结构对齐，我们从两个互补视角研究令牌级学习信号。首先，我们引入一种前缀感知加权方案，即“前置更大加权”，它根据令牌对减少候选物品间语义歧义的贡献来强调令牌。其次，频率加权增加对低频令牌的学习重视，解决长尾问题。
tldr: 提出一种多目标框架，通过前置感知加权和频率加权来优化生成式推荐器中的令牌级训练目标，以更好地匹配语义ID的结构特性。
en_tdlr: Proposes a multi-target framework that optimizes token-level training objectives in generative recommenders via prefix-aware weighting and frequency weighting to better align with semantic ID structures.
